subject: Support stack contract review and consolidation options (Zendesk / Intercom)
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Cc: olga.petrov@redwood.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CS tooling RFP + next steps

Team — attaching the consolidated RFP and a baseline comparison of Zendesk, Intercom, and Gainsight. Procurement asked for our preferred approach by EOD next Friday so they can include it in the Q1 vendor commit. High-level asks: pricing clarity for 12/24 month terms, data residency & SOC2 evidence, SSO + SCIM support, and any volume discounts for multi-product bundles.

Attachments: CS_Tooling_RFP_2026.pdf (PDF)

Primary options I'm considering: 1) Renew Zendesk and add Intercom for web chat (split) 2) Pilot Intercom for In-App, move Zendesk to ticket-only 3) Consolidate on Zendesk with Gainsight for success workflow. Please review the comparison and callouts in the last section.

Can each of you flag the top 2 risks from your perspective and a recommendation? I'll collate and share with procurement/legal.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CS tooling RFP + next steps

On Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 09:12, Hannah Schmitt wrote:
> Team — attaching the consolidated RFP...

Thanks Hannah — quick notes from CS ops: top risks are (1) data portability between Intercom and Zendesk (we've had issues exporting full conversation history in the past) and (2) latency for in-app messaging if we route through a secondary provider. Recommendation: pilot Intercom for in-app for 3 months with strict success metrics (MTTR, response SLA, CSAT), then decide on consolidation.

I can own the pilot success metrics and set up the dashboard. If procurement wants to accelerate, a 12-month Intercom pilot with a break clause at 90 days would be my preference.

-Marissa
Senior Manager, CS Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@zendesk.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, claire.morgan@lawfirm.com
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 14:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Zendesk proposal and answers to SOC2/terms questions

Hannah — attaching our proposal and a short answers doc for SOC2 and data residency. High-level:
- 12-month list-price for Support Suite: $162,000/year (customized enterprise tier); 24-month term reduces to $150,000/year.
- SOC2 Type II report available, we can provide a copy under NDA.
- We support SSO (SAML) + SCIM provisioning; regional hosting available (us/eu).

Attachments: zendesk_proposal_Q1_2026.pdf (PDF)

If you share the redlines, I can send a tracked changes contract and a consolidated quote by next week. Happy to join a quick call to walk procurement/legal through the legal terms.

Best,
Jordan Hayes
Enterprise Sales, Zendesk

From: Priya Shah <pshah@intercom.io>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Intercom commercial note + pilot proposal

Hi Hannah/Marissa — thanks for the RFP. We recommend a focused pilot for Intercom in-app + Inbox for web chat. Proposed commercial: 6 month pilot at $20k/month (credits applied towards 12-month term if you convert), includes data export tooling and a dedicated solutions engineer for onboarding. SOC2 and compliance pack attached; we can provide a sub-processor list.

Attachment: intercom_comparison_matrix.xlsx (XLSX)

We are flexible on the pilot KPIs — recommend response SLA 60s for web, NA average handle time below 6 minutes, and CSAT >=4.0 for pilot success. Let me know if you'd like to sync this week.

Regards,
Priya Shah
Customer Solutions, Intercom

From: Claire Morgan <claire.morgan@lawfirm.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 11:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Redwood contract redlines (draft attached)

Hannah — I reviewed Zendesk's standard EA. Primary items I redlined: liability cap (we should seek $5M or annual spend whichever is greater), data return and deletion timelines (30 days), and tighter breach notification windows (48 hours). Also added a mutual termination for convenience with 60 days' notice for pilots. I annotated the doc where we need commercial concessions (credits, price protection).

Attachment: redwood_contract_redlines.docx (DOCX)

If you want, I can push a shorter redline set to Jordan to see what they'll accept commercially before formal DocuSign.

-Claire
External Counsel

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, dylan.brooks@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@zendesk.com>, Priya Shah <pshah@intercom.io>, Claire Morgan <claire.morgan@lawfirm.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 15:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Decision path: pilot + negotiation ask to vendors

Team — thanks for the fast turnaround. Summary and decision path:
1) We will run a dual-track pilot: Intercom for in-app + Zendesk for full ticketing. Pilot term: 90 days with clear KPIs (Marissa to own metrics).
2) Procurement to request the following from vendors before signing: a) 90-day mutual termination clause for the pilot b) price protection for conversion to 12-month term c) SOC2 Type II under NDA and sub-processor disclosure d) explicit data export tooling and timeline (30 days).
3) Legal to push the liability cap language as noted; ask for credits if SLA misses in pilot.

Marissa — please draft the pilot SOW and KPI dashboard. Olga — once Marissa has the SOW, coordinate with procurement to get vendor quotes into the procurement queue. Claire — please prepare a short cover note for the vendors with the redlines to test commercial response.

Attachments referenced: CS_Tooling_RFP_2026.pdf, zendesk_proposal_Q1_2026.pdf, intercom_comparison_matrix.xlsx, redwood_contract_redlines.docx

I'll schedule a 30-minute sync next Tuesday 9am PT to finalize the SOW and ask list. Going to loop in procurement after that call.

Hannah
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference
